Absolutely! In relationships, some people might refer to "not getting a 'line'" to mean a lack of clear communication or understanding between partners. This can lead to misinterpretations, frustrations, and feelings of isolation.

From a psychological perspective, it's essential to maintain open and honest communication in relationships. If one partner feels they're not getting a "line," it might be due to various factors such as poor listening skills, emotional distance, or even different love languages.

On a personal note, I've experienced this in past relationships. It was challenging, and I had to learn to express my feelings more openly and listen more actively to my partner. I found that when we improved our communication, our relationship became stronger and more fulfilling.
